batting.name: JEC Franklin
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b P Kumar

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c N Saini b P Awana

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c Mandeep Singh b P Awana

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c SD Chitnis b P Kumar

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c JEC Franklin b KA Pollard

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b KA Pollard

batting.name: Azhar Mahmood
batting.dismissal: c NLTC Perera b PP Ojha

balls.text: pitched on middle, drives it down towards deep midwicket, a single is all he'll manage
comes down the track and drives that towards deep extra cover for a single
a wide, this one is down the leg side, Rayudu shuffled across there and tried to clip it fine, missed, close calls this over for wides, a couple were a touch harsh, like this one
pitched up and he frees his arms, cracks that wide of extra cover into the deep for a single
called a wide again, slips it really wide outside off, he leaves that one alone
called a wide, full and wide and Perera fails to reach it
banged in short on middle, a legitimate bouncer, Thisara swayed out of the way there, another dot ball
on a length on middle, chipped down towards long-on for a single
low full toss, drives that straight to extra cover for a single
that was bowled on a length outside off and Perera let it through, called a wide
pitched up outside off, drags it past the bowler for a single down towards long-on
short of a good length on middle and leg, turns it towards square leg for a single
two in two, a low full toss this time and Harbhajan can't middle it, ends up slicing it to cover
Franklin holes out, that was a full toss and he would have wanted to dispatch that into the stands, didn't connect it well enough, skied it and Miller judged it well at long-on
low full toss outside off and he middles that, drills that wide of Miller at long-on, struck straight and struck hard, gets four
low full toss outside off, squeezed wide of third man in the deep for a couple of runs
Mid-off is up and he clears him, a length ball on the off and he just manages to clear the fielder in the circle, gets four for it
missed run-out, pushed towards extra cover, Franklin's well out of his ground and David Hussey misses

Pollard goes, he struck that sweetly but was taken superbly at deep midwicket, length ball and it was swung hard but Mandeep Singh was positioned perfectly there, timed his jump perfectly and snapped a sharp one in the deep, a big wicket. He moved a few paces to his left there did Mandeep
in the blockhole outside off, dug out towards extra cover for a single
slower one bowled short, smashed back towards Franklin who takes it on his foot, ends up being a single
banged that in short and Pollard was surprised by that one, went for the pull but missed, a good bouncer
slower one bowled slightly short outside off, played wide of point for a single
nicely chipped away, pitched up on middle and he flicks that between long-on and deep midwicket, superbly timed, a one bounce four
pitched on a length and it's cracked towards long-on for a single
low full toss on middle, drives that one straight to long-on for a single
banged in short on middle and he ducks under that one
in the blockhole outside off, dug out into the off side for a single
shortish on the off, lunges forward and presents the full face
quicker through the air, bowled flat on the off, drops that one into the off side
turning away from a good length, gets forward and tries to open the face, misses as it turns away
quicker through the air on middle, drives that through midwicket for a single

run-out, Karthik's gone, played a nice shot, lofting that inside out over extra cover, there was two on offer there but Franklin backed out of the second there, Karthik was already halfway down the pitch and by the time he turned back, it was too late, Chawla collected and threw down the stumps at the non-striker's end
Chawla bowls that short on the off, it's pushed straight to point

excellent fielding in the deep but poor in the infield at extra cover, low full toss and that was driven past the extra cover fielder who dived over it, Miller ran a fair distance to his left from long-off, dived full length and hauled it back in, threw to the striker's end and scored a direct hit, but Karthik was back in, run-out appeal but he's made it back, superb stuff from Miller though
pitched up outside off, that's driven wide of long-off, firmly, for a couple thanks to a misfield
low full toss on the off, drives it to long-off for a single
spotted the slower one, Punjab are clueless, on middle and off, stood his ground and swung it away into the second tier behind deep square leg
another one, poor delivery from Praveen, full toss on the off and it's thrashed through extra cover
Franklin's looking dangerous, had made up his mind, that landed on a length and he middled it, launching it miles into the crowd behind deep midwicket
slower one, lands full on the off and it's driven back to the bowler
full toss, would have wanted more than the two he got, driven towards deep midwicket, raises the 50 stand
third man is up and the runs continue to flow, short of a good length outside off, chops that wide of that fielder for another boundary
short of a good length on the off, chops that in front of point for a single
short of a good length on middle, turns it wide of square leg into the leg side for a single
full toss on the pads and that's been given the treatment, Karthik flicks that away past short fine for four more, 100 up
Karthik misses out, well wide down the leg side, can't quite scoop it over short fine this time, just the single
drops that into the off side for a single, Franklin reaches his half-century, good steady innings
round the wicket again, goes for the slog-sweep, misses and is struck on the back leg
fires in a quicker one and Karthik spots it well, lands full and he slog-sweeps that over midwicket to beat the gap in the deep
enterprising batting, gets forward, converts that into a full toss and reverse-sweeps that over point for a boundary
shortish on the off, chopped towards point from the crease
Karthik gets it right this time, the push Mumbai needed, full toss on the pads and that's scooped over short fine
straight into Karthik's arm at the other end, Franklin drives that powerfully, it hits the non-striker and ricochets off his arm towards long-on, just the single
full toss on leg stump and Karthik was looking to scoop it fine, missed out there, got a thick inside edge, just the single
pitched up on the off, cracked towards long-off for a single
full toss and it's been punished, on middle and he connects superbly, sending this one further, in front of the electronic scoreboard behind the deep midwicket boundary
Franklin sends that into the stands, round the wicket, lands on middle and off, Franklin opens up and swings that miles over deep midwicket
short on middle, pulled wide of Praveen at deep square leg for a couple of runs
the googly, flat and short on the off, Franklin spotted it, defended it wide of extra cover for one more
short outside off, waits for it to turn away and cuts it down to deep point for a single
bowled that on a good length, defended calmly towards cover
drops that one in front of cover, Karthik calls and completes a quick single
bowled that flat on middle and off, gets forward and works that through midwicket for a single
good length, cracked in front of extra cover for a quick single
fires that full on middle, it's driven through midwicket into the deep for a single
lands on a good length and this one nips away, Karthik gets forward and leaves that one alone
nipped back in, Karthik wasn't expecting that, rocked forward to defend, clipped the pads on the way to the keeper
Rohit goes! Punjab are doing well here, length ball, he charges down the track to smack that down the ground, it took the outside edge and the keeper took it easily
goodish length on middle and off, plays that back towards the bowler
flighted outside off, eased through cover into the deep for a single
drilled towards extra cover where David Hussey got a hand to it and kept them down to just a single
bowled it flat on the off, gets across and scoops it down towards fine leg for a couple of runs
shortish on the off, gets back and punches it towards long-on for a single
tossed up on middle, drives that one inside out towards extra cover

run-out, Tendulkar has to walk back, turned it away through square leg, Tendulkar wanted the second, Miller runs in from deep midwicket and returns an accurate throw, Tendulkar had no chance, was well short as the bails were taken off
lands on a length outside off, drives it uppishly but gets to long-off on the bounce
short of a good length outside off, guides that one down to third man for a single
short of a length outside off, tries to cut that square but misses
pitcked the length early, shortish, stand stall and pulls it hard over midwicket for a one bounce four

dropped at short fine, Awana's the man, shortish and slow, he moved across to scoop it over short fine, came off the glove and Awana dived to his right but couldn't hold on, was an easy catch but it goes down
pitched on the pads, lands full, driven through midwicket into the deep for a single
the googly again, bowled it short outside off, taps it down to short third
turning away and he punches that towards extra cover
chips that flat delivery towards long-on for a single
the googly, short of a good length, turns away, gets forward and is deceived, does well to retain his balance
gets forward and turns it wide of midwicket for a single
tossed up on middle, drives that down to long-on for a single
pitched up and driven uppishly but on the bounce to mid-off, he's unhappy not to have dispatched that
appeal for a catch and it's called a wide, Tendulkar moved across and tried to hook it, missed, was far away from the glove and too high
spotted the slower one early, landed in the slot and he smacked it hard over the bowler's head for another boundary
delicately done, used the pace of the ball, waited for that one to come on and opened the face at the last moment, beat third man to the boundary
pitched on a length, strides forward and drives it to mid-off for a single
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and works it away to deep square leg for a single
short of a length outside off, he gets back and cuts it straight to point
short of a good length on the off, tried to chop it square, got a thick inside edge, went back to the bowler
cut away, back of a length outside off and he cracked it behind point to beat third man to the boundary
short of a good length outside off, crunched it straight to point
short on middle, gets across and pulls it through square leg for a single
smashed but good fielding at extra cover, short of a good length, he charged out and smacked it on the up but could not get it past extra cover
pitched up first up, driven wide of mid-off, just a single
short, waits for it to turn in and whips it through square leg into the deep for a single
picked the gap again, slightly short on middle and off and he picks it over square leg once more, pulled it over the in-field
nicely swept, angled towards off, he got across and swept it hard over square leg, short fine was in place and he found the gap to earn a boundary
makes a bit of room and Bhatt chases him, turned wide of square leg for a single
full toss, chipped that towards long-on on the bounce for a single
flat and short on the off, comes down the track and plays it away to point
nicely done, short of a good length, came down the track and punched it through point and cover for a couple of runs
pushed forward towards mid-on and they steal a quick single, Tendulkar, running to the danger end, completes the single
driven straight to extra cover, no single on offer there

appeal for lbw, looked close, was there an inside edge, no according to the umpire, Swung in and Tendulkar tried to flick it, was a fair distance from the bat and struck him on the pads, appeared to strike him in line, the only doubt there was whether it would have missed leg. Doubt it, may have gone on to hit leg, close call
flicked away for four this time, a touch too straight from Praveen, got forward and clipped it through square leg, Awana ran from fine leg to stop that and dived but dived over it in the end
goodish length on the off, gets across and flicks that straight to square leg, nicely played but straight to the fielder
sweeps that towards short fine for a single
excellent fielding, almost a catch, landed just short of Piyush at cover, moved away and cracked it hard but got to the fielder on the half-volley
tossed up on middle, goes for the sweep, it turns away and strikes him on the pads, struck him on the back leg, would have missed off
gets front and across to short of a good length ball and punches it through midwicket into the deep for a single
shortish outside off, Tendulkar waits for it to turn away and guides it behind short third man for a single
angling in from round the wicket, shortish on the off, turning away, Tendulkar defends it into the off side
beaten, excellent over from Praveen, starts with a maiden, lands on a length and beats Franklin like he did the first three balls, the batsman drives loosely and misses
gets forward, Praveen comes round the wicket, Franklin gets in front and opens the face, playing it behind point, no run on offer there
short of a good length outside off, leaves this one alone now, shoulders arms to that one
swing and beaten, three in a row, Franklin gets forward and pushes at it, loosely, misses once again
beaten again, steps forward to drive and Praveen gets it to move away to beat the edge again, lovely delivery
swinging away and beats the outside edge, lands on a length and Franklin pushes at it, misses
comfortable two, Kings XI won, he made room and Perera chased him, landed full and that was driven wide of long-off for a couple
full on the off, drives it in front of extra cover for a single

a decisive blow, an extraordinary shot, low full toss, Marsh made a bit of room and sliced it, the bottom hand came off, there is a deep point in place but that cleared him, Kings XI have it in control
flicked away towards deep square leg to keep the strike
was waiting for it and promptly dispatched it, short and slow, dragged it on middle, pulled away miles into the stands behind deep midwicket, thrashed
full toss and he mistimes it to long-off for a single, the pressure builds on Kings XI, four good balls from Munaf
Marsh steps away, trying to clear midwicket, but is struck on the pads, just a leg-bye in the end as it strikes him on the pads
low full toss on middle, drives it towards long-on, just the single, Pollard cuts that off
pitched up on middle, trying for the yorker, drags it through midwicket for a single
flicked that one straight to square leg, can't get it past him, a dot ball
ooh, just landed short of midwicket, flicked it towards midwicket and it got to him on the half volley, just the single
full toss on the pads, he comes down the track and turns it towards deep backward square leg for a single
poor stuff from Ojha, another wide fired down the leg side and though Marsh misses on the sweep, Karthik can't collect it cleanly, two more runs
strikes it straight to Thisara at long-off this time, similar delivery but didn't time it as well, straight into the hands of Thisara who hardly had to move
Mahmood middles that one, bowled on a length outside off and he struck it hard through the line, Thisara was was standing at the edge of the ropes and it just managed to clear him
slips that one wide, down the leg side, and they get another run plus one more as Karthik fumbles
short outside off, swatted towards extra cover, didn't middle it, for a single
A shocker from Ojha, full and way too wide and it's called
low full toss outside off, it was the opening Marsh was looking for, drilled it hard through extra cover for a boundary, it brings up his half-century
doesn't strike it as well as he would have liked, short ball on leg and it's pulled towards deep square leg for two more
Marsh misses out, a full toss on the pads and he would love to have dispatched it over short fine, missed, was struck on the pads
full toss on middle, smashes it down to long-on for a single
slower one bowled on a length outside off, cracks it over extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
good ball, yorker on the off, he can only dig it out for a single
shortish on the off, punched off the back foot to cover, a dot ball, just one off the over, Pollard's bowled a crucial over here
bowls that short outside off, chopped down towards point
short one, chopped it towards Munaf at point for a single
appeal for a catch, slower one bowled short outside off, Marsh tries to run it down, Pollard appeals belatedly, the umpire's not having any of it
Hussey goes, Pollard dragged that one short, Hussey came down the track and went for the pull but ended up top-edging it, holed out to deep square leg, Rayudu ran in and took it well
short of a good length on middle, drops that into the off side
length ball and that's been punished, in the slot for Marsh and he was shaping up for it, thrashes it flat over long-on for a powerful six
short of a good length outside off, runs that one down to third man for a single, makes some room and gets a run
pitched up on the off, cracks that one towards long-off for a single
pitched up outside off, strikes it uppishly over extra cover, two more in the deep
Pollard does superbly in the deep, dives full length to his right and drags that in, short and it's thumped down the ground but Pollard saved two runs there
smacked for four, drags it short and Marsh is in complete control of that one, pulls it away over square leg
full outside off, driven through extra cover in the deep for a single
down the leg side, Marsh bends down to play the sweep, misses, called a wide
fires it full on the off, cracks it down towards long-on for a single
chips that one towards long-off for a single
bowled it short on middle, pulled away on the bounce to deep square leg
fires it full outside off, squeezed past point for a single
quicker through the air, comes down the track and chips it on the bounce to deep midwicket
Munaf made to work in the deep, pitched up well outside off, steers that one through point and Munaf kept them down to a couple
bowled on a length outside off, dragged it towards long-on for a single
found the gap, made a bit of room, Perera dragged it short and Hussey pulled it well between long-on and deep midwicket
short and Marsh sensed a chance, tried to pull that hard over midwicket but ended up bottom-edging it, just the single
short and wide, cut away down towards deep point for a single
short of a good length outside off, pushed past point for a single
wristily done, whipped through midwicket into the deep to keep strike
shortish on middle, punches it down the pitch back to the bowler
comes down the track and punches that one through midwicket for a couple of runs
pushed it short and quick on middle, turned past square leg for one more
worked that one away through square leg for a single
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it to long-on for a single
pitched on a length on middle, drives it down towards long-on for a single
shortish on middle, worked away through square leg for a single
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and knocks it down in front of the bowler
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and drops it dead on the pitch
bowled on a good length on the off, knocks it down in front of point and gets a single
bowled that short outside off, it's been slashed to third man for a single
straying on the pads from round the wicket and Marsh sweeps that fine, fine leg is inside the circle and he gets another four, 14 off the over
short ball on the off, makes room and cuts it hard, hard through point for a boundary
flighted on middle, drives it wide of midwicket, a single on offer and they take it
gets forward and defends that one into the off side
beaten by the straight one, tossed up on the off and he closed the face on it, took the outside edge and beat short third for a boundary
knocks htat one down towards point and steals a quick single, a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Marsh is comfortably in
holes out, Pollard celebrates, good length and he swings it high but straight to Franklin standing at deep midwicket, was the slower one and he didn't middle it
slower one bowled short outside off, chops that behind point
slightly short on leg stump, pushes that down the pitch
shortish on  the off, tries to drag that hard past midwicket, ends up hitting it straight to the fielder
drops that one in front of point, decides against the single, wisely so
goodish length on the off, gets across and turns it through square for a single
tried to sweep this one fine but couldn't connect properly, struck the pads and dropped dead

flighted on middle, drives it through extra cover into the deep, just eased it through the off side, it was all timing and had enough legs on it to go all the way to the boundary, beat the diving Rohit Sharma at extra cover and another diving Rayudu in the deep
shortish outside off, dropped it into the off side and snuck a single
leading edge again, on middle and leg, ends up getting more bat on it and it lands safely behind cover, a couple of runs
and again, this one turned in but he closed the face a little early on that one, got a leading edge and it landed short of Harbhajan
went on straight, deceived the batsman who, expecting it to turn in, tried to close the face, was beaten
well fielded by Pollard in the deep, chipped over extra cover, he made his way across from long-off and stopped it with one hand, keep them to just a single
comes down the track and tickles it down behind square for a single
shortish on the off, rocks back and cuts it through point for a single
flighted on middle, drives that past midwicket for a single

trapped in front, came round the wicket and angled it towards middle, Saini got across and tried to work it square against the turn, struck in line as it straightened and it would have probably gone on to knock middle and off
angling in towards the off stump, pushed into the off side
chipped and it lands right in between midwicket and Franklin running in from deep square leg, got across and flicked it but didn't get hold, was lucky in the end
appeal for lbw, gets front and across to work it square, struck high on the back leg, would have probably gone over the stumps
strayed on the pads and he tried to work it fine, and succeeded, came off the thigh but he'll take it, it's given a four
short of a good length, tried to open the face again but was surprised by the bounce, beaten
slower one, made room and Pollard dragged it short, opened the face and it landed just wide of the off stump, almost guided it back onto the stumps
good length on the off, drops it in front of cover and steams across for a single, attempt at a direct hit but he was in
worked away off the back foot for a single through midwicket
short on middle, punched into the leg side, uppishly, off the back foot for a single
Munaf at long-off is being made to work, tossed up and that's lofted inside out over extra cover, Munaf runs across and drags it in, two more
flighted outside off, pushes it down to long-off for one more
reaches forward and drives it down to long-off for a single
lovely shot, good start by Punjab, this, tossed up outside off and it's driven elegantly over extra cover for a one bounce four
angling away, he runs that one down to third man for a single
back of a length on the off, knocks it down into the off side

banged it short and he pulled it over midwicket, wasn't middled but it had enough on it to go to the boundary, Franklin ran across in the deep, tried to drag it in but his right hand came in the way and it rebounded towards the ropes
short of a good length, rocks on the back foot and turns it into the leg side
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and plays it past the bowler
bowled on a length outside off, got forward to drive that through extra cover, got a thick inside edge
goodish length on the off, punched on the up straight to mid-off
wristily done, turned it away through the leg side for a couple, short of a good length and he whipped it square
good length outside off, comes down the track and tries to launch that over mid-off, missed it
bowled it short on the off, seized the length early and pulled it away through square leg for a boundary
smashed, comes down the track and thwacks him over mid-off, powerfully hit
pulled away, not in control, there is a man around deep midwicket too, but it's gone through him
excellent delivery, that came back in too much from back of a length into the right-hander, it was delivered across him, but then reared back in to him, he had no way of playing that, beaten
defended from the crease

missed chance for a run-out, that should have been gone, Mandeep had pushed towards extra cover and set off, he had no chance of beating the throw, the fielder only had to lob the ball towards the non-striker's stumps, but he missed
tries to cut a back of a length ball going across him, mistimes it into the ground
gets forward and pushes a full delivery, to extra cover
softly steered down to third man
clobbered through cover, Mandeep makes some room outside leg, and goes hard at this length ball which flies through the off side
defends a short of a length ball back to Munaf
too close to cut, but he does, the ball wasn't rising much as well, and he gets a thick inside edge past the keeper on the leg side
drives a pitched up ball wide of mid off, Sachin misses with the throw at the non-striker's, would have been close
